title: Entralink progress ids
description: The next progress ids the editor's Entree page gives (room.schema.json's progress_id): a new battle gets next_battle, a new catchable enemy next_catch, a new room (rooms/ only) next_room, and the number goes up, so a deleted battle's or catch's number is never given again (a save keeps its bit). Written by the editor on save; never lower them.

next_battle.description: The next battle's won-ever bit; at most 1024 battles

next_catch.description: The next catchable enemy's caught-ever bit; at most 512 catches

next_room.description: The next room's record id (its discovered and beaten bits and its boss record); at most 128 rooms
